description: Validates the complete canvas session lifecycle: template picker → goal input → canvas created → session running → pause → resume → complete → closure overlay → skip → completed.

steps.title: Start canvas session
steps.description: Triggers the canvas session flow via the command palette. The CanvasTemplatePickerModal should appear.
steps.expectedInput: Plugin enabled, no active canvas session
steps.expectedOutput: CanvasTemplatePickerModal is visible with template cards

steps.title: Select a canvas template
steps.description: Clicks the first template card in the CanvasTemplatePickerModal. The InputModal for the session goal should appear.
steps.expectedOutput: InputModal appears with goal input field

actions.description: InputModal with goal field is visible

steps.title: Enter goal and start session
steps.description: Types a session goal into the InputModal and clicks Start. The canvas file should be created and a session started.
steps.expectedInput: InputModal with goal input is visible
steps.expectedOutput: Session started, canvas file created, modal closed

steps.title: Verify canvas file opened
steps.description: Checks that the canvas file was created and is open in the workspace.
steps.expectedInput: Canvas session started, canvas file created
steps.expectedOutput: A canvas leaf is active in the workspace

steps.title: Verify canvas session state
steps.description: Checks the plugin's SessionService to confirm an active canvas session exists with the correct type.
steps.expectedOutput: Active session has type 'canvas-session' and status 'running'

actions.code: (() => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['{{PLUGIN_ID}}']; if (!p || !p.sessionService) return 'no-plugin'; const s = p.sessionService.getActiveSession(); if (!s) return 'no-session'; return JSON.stringify({ type: s.type, status: s.status }); })()
actions.description: Active session is canvas-session in running status

steps.title: Pause the canvas session
steps.description: Emits session.pause via the EventBus to pause the active canvas session.

actions.code: (() => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['{{PLUGIN_ID}}']; const s = p?.sessionService?.getActiveSession(); return s ? s.id : ''; })()

(() => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['{{PLUGIN_ID}}']; const sessions = p.sessionService.state?.sessions ?? []; const s = sessions.find(s => s.id === '{{sessionId}}'); return s ? s.status : 'not-found'; })()

steps.title: Resume the canvas session
steps.description: Emits session.resume via the EventBus to resume the paused canvas session. The canvas file should be re-focused.

actions.code: (() => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['{{PLUGIN_ID}}']; const sessions = p.sessionService.state?.sessions ?? []; const s = sessions.find(s => s.type === 'canvas-session' && s.status === 'paused'); return s ? s.id : ''; })()
(() => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['{{PLUGIN_ID}}']; const s = p.sessionService.getActiveSession(); return s ? s.status : 'not-found'; })()

steps.title: Complete the canvas session
steps.description: Emits session.complete to finish the session. The session enters 'reviewing' status and the closure overlay appears in the sidebar.
steps.expectedOutput: Session status is 'reviewing', closure overlay visible in sidebar

actions.code: (() => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['{{PLUGIN_ID}}']; const s = p.sessionService.getActiveSession(); return s ? s.id : ''; })()

steps.title: Skip closure ritual
steps.description: Clicks the Skip button on the closure overlay to bypass the ritual. The session transitions from 'reviewing' to 'completed'.
steps.expectedInput: Session in 'reviewing' status, closure overlay visible

actions.code: (() => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['{{PLUGIN_ID}}']; const sessions = p.sessionService.state?.sessions ?? []; const s = sessions.find(s => s.type === 'canvas-session'); return s ? s.status : 'not-found'; })()
